assessments.explanation: The thylakoid lumen holds the proton motive force built by electron transport. A proton-permeable membrane collapses that gradient, so ATP synthase cannot phosphorylate ADP to ATP, while electron flow itself may continue.
assessments.match: thylakoid membrane becomes permeable to protons
assessments.source_anchor: Section 3, Thylakoid Lumen: acidified interior compartment across which a transmembrane proton motive force is established.
